hypothesis: A VCP breakout is a claim that demand has accepted price above the pivot. If the first completed post-entry bars close back below that same pivot, the claim has failed and exiting next open should reduce no-follow losses without truncating leaders that immediately expand.
unique_change: Keep the frozen candidate stream, entry, ranking, market regime, 5% hard stop, MA20 exit, 40-bar maximum hold, staged profit locks, costs and portfolio rules. Add a next-open exit after any completed post-breakout close below that setup's pivot.
causal_contract: The pivot is frozen from the signal-time VCP structure. The breakout bar cannot trigger the added exit. Only later completed closes can emit an exit signal, which is filled at the next tradable open.
stop_condition: Run this thesis-level exit once. If loss reduction requires sacrificing the right-tail gate, stop this rule; do not add buffers, confirmation days, or pivot percentages on the exposed interval.
development_note: The entire interval is exposed development data. This is a method diagnosis, not independent validation or live qualification.
